title: Crystal Studies
description: Five independent hyper-surreal portraits of different crystal-material mountain structures suspended over water, each standing on its own.
creative_direction: Each single image explores a different crystal species and composition language: amethyst column, quartz natural bridge, obsidian spire, topaz glacier, and diamond plateau. All feel like 35mm large-format field photographs of impossible geology.
